display_name: Two Red Months, One Green Month, Current Green Week
description: Long multi-timeframe entry selection after two consecutive completed red monthly candles, followed by one completed green month and the first completed green weekly candle in the current month.

deterministic_steps: At the end of every completed trading week in current calendar month M(n), use only daily bars available by that week close.
Build completed monthly candles from corporate-action-adjusted daily OHLC data.
Build the completed current-month weekly candle using only trading sessions of that week that fall inside M(n).
Require the completed weekly candle Close above Open.
Emit only the first qualifying long entry intent for the symbol in M(n).
Fill at the next trading session open under the shared execution model.

assumptions: Only completed monthly candles M(n-3), M(n-2) and M(n-1) are used; the incomplete current monthly candle is never used.
A weekly candle is considered only after the final trading session of that calendar trading week.
The first and last partial weeks of a month are clipped to sessions inside the month so that the current-month confirmation does not use prior-month days.
Doji monthly or weekly candles do not satisfy red or green requirements.
No exit, stop, timeout or carry rule is owned by this strategy.
